component: EC124 Liquid Air Energy Storage (LAES / CES)
description: Extends F1a with cold loss during storage (BOR ~0.5%/day T_amb dependent), ambient T effect on cold recycle effectiveness, and discharge efficiency vs T_amb
source: Morgan et al. (2015), Applied Energy, 137, 845-853; Sciacovelli et al. (2017), Applied Energy, 190, 84-98; Guizzi et al. (2015), Energy, 93, 1, 1382-1394

boil_off_T_coeff.note: BOR increases by 0.01%/day per 1K above T_amb_ref: BOR(T) = BOR_ref*(1 + k*(T_amb - T_ref))

cold_recycle_T_coeff.note: Cold recycle eff changes by -0.3%/K above T_ref: eps(T) = eps_ref*(1 + k*(T_amb - T_ref))

discharge_work_T_coeff.note: Discharge specific work decreases 0.2%/K above T_ref due to reduced cold recovery
